name: a heavy blade
description: Old iron, well-balanced. Someone cared for this once.
_essence_note: Heavier iron, more mass behind the edge. The dissolution is stronger — it cuts deeper into structure.

movesets.name: Press
movesets.description: The blade carries momentum. On a killing blow, press forward.

movesets.name: Rending Strike
movesets.description: Tear through what protects. The armour will not survive.
